Class NetworkTagBuffer<T>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.nio.TagBuffer<T>
com.saicone.nbt.nio.NetworkTagBuffer<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the tag object implementation.
public class NetworkTagBuffer<T> extends TagBuffer<T>
A tag buffer that do the same functionality as TagBuffer but manages integers as VarInt32, longs as VarInt64 and String size as unsigned VarInt32.
This implementation aims to be same as Minecraft Bedrock network data decoding/encoding.
